name: Scoundrel
resourceDesc: Nerve, a pool of a hundred, built by blade strikes (Quick Cut, and every swing of the dirk) and spent on verses and finishers; it comes back between fights.
identity: A blade and a voice: a street scoundrel who fights with a dirk and a song, and talks his way through the rest. CANON-EXPANDED: Valen, the canon's own street-level scoundrel (world_bible.md), sang a jagged verse when his hands were gone (book 3 ch. 4); the Glass Coast's Glimmer, the sound of trade, laughter and the scoundrel's wit (book 3 ch. 11); Matriarch Vala's Command Voice, "Stay." (book 1 ch. 23). No bard order exists in the canon. Singing, no instrument. No machines.

branches.name: Cutthroat
branches.loop: Quick Cut for Nerve, keep Poisoned Wine in the wound, Mark the Debt, and Settle the Score when your Nerve runs high.
branches.tradeoff: Everything lands on one foe: a pack is cut down one throat at a time.

nodes.name: Settle the Score
nodes.desc: Learn Settle the Score: a finisher that spends all your Nerve on one hard cut.

nodes.name: Keen Dirk
nodes.desc: Quick Cut and Settle the Score deal 4% more per rank.

nodes.name: Steady Nerve
nodes.desc: Quick Cut builds 2 more Nerve per rank.

nodes.name: Poisoned Wine
nodes.desc: Learn Poisoned Wine: the target takes damage every 2 seconds for 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Strong Vintage
nodes.desc: Poisoned Wine deals 10% more per rank.

nodes.name: Mark the Debt
nodes.desc: Learn Mark the Debt: a fifth of your blows on the marked foe comes due as one hard blow.

nodes.name: Compounding
nodes.desc: The debt owes 5% more of your blows per rank.

nodes.name: Paid in Full
nodes.desc: A debt that comes due on a foe under 35% health lands double.

branches.name: Silver Tongue
branches.loop: Glimmer the pack before the fight, Jagged Verse the caster, and Stay the one that breaks loose.
branches.tradeoff: A dazed foe wakes at the first blow: the party must leave it be.

nodes.name: Glimmer
nodes.desc: Learn Glimmer: the target and up to three foes near it stand dazed for 8 seconds.

nodes.name: Long Glimmer
nodes.desc: Glimmer holds 1 second longer per rank.

nodes.name: Silver Voice
nodes.desc: Glimmer and Jagged Verse cost 3 less Nerve per rank.

nodes.name: Jagged Verse
nodes.desc: Learn Jagged Verse: it stops a spell, silences for 3 seconds and slows the foes near.

nodes.name: Sour Note
nodes.desc: Jagged Verse slows 5% more, and comes back 1 second sooner, per rank.

nodes.name: Stay
nodes.desc: Learn Stay: one word holds the target for 4 seconds, and blows do not break it.

nodes.name: Held Word
nodes.desc: Stay holds half a second longer per rank.

nodes.name: The Whole Room
nodes.desc: Glimmer takes a fifth foe, and reaches 2 metres further.

branches.name: Fixer
branches.loop: Sing the War-Verse all fight, Rally when the pools run low, Bribe the extra hand, and call in a Favour when it counts.
branches.tradeoff: Little damage of your own: your worth is in everyone else's.

nodes.name: War-Verse
nodes.desc: Learn the War-Verse: while you sing it, the party's blows land 6% harder.

nodes.name: Rousing Verse
nodes.desc: The War-Verse lifts the party's blows 1% more per rank.

nodes.name: Good Company
nodes.desc: While you sing the War-Verse, the party within 15 metres takes 2% less per rank.

nodes.name: Rallying Verse
nodes.desc: Learn the Rallying Verse: for 10 seconds you gain 3 Nerve a second, and Mira 3 mana.

nodes.name: Bribe
nodes.desc: Learn Bribe: a foe that can be bought stops fighting for 15 seconds.

nodes.name: Deep Pockets
nodes.desc: A Bribe holds 5 seconds longer per rank.

nodes.name: Call in a Favour
nodes.desc: Learn Call in a Favour: the ally with the longest wait has it cut by 10 seconds.

nodes.name: Old Friends
nodes.desc: Call in a Favour cuts 3 seconds more per rank.

nodes.name: Everyone's Friend
nodes.desc: While you sing the War-Verse, Mira casts 10% faster.
